name: Trail
author: hundekraft
description: Hold a note and Trail plays a short phrase in your scale. Each phrase is built from a short idea of four or eight steps that comes back, changed a little, and the phrase ends on the root or a chord tone. Leave it running and Trail keeps working on that idea: it moves a bit of the tune up a step, turns it upside down or plays it backwards, so the phrase drifts somewhere new while you play over it.
